snippet.title: Trailer "she danced in the wind like a holographic dream before the world died"
snippet.description:
Play it here: https://alienmelon.itch.io/flower
"she danced in the wind like a holographic dream before the world died" is a short game poem and interactive fiction about The End.
You play the very last flower left on Earth, brining peace to long dead soil.
Explore brutalist ruins to collect memories of a dead world.
Maybe your presence can heal what is left.
